name: AH 4289
title: Honors Thesis Research in Allied Health Sciences
description: Thesis research experience under the guidance and supervision of a department faculty member; designed to engage a student in advanced independent inquiry and investigation on a topic of interest. Research conducted in this course is intended to contribute to the completion of the student’s thesis in AH 4297W Honors Thesis in Allied Health Sciences. Learning agreement, and supporting documentation required. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
requirement_description: Open only with consent of instructor, advisor and department head.
